limitations.description: second opinion is a clause-structure re-derivation from the same wasm grammars; a grammar bug shared by both paths would be invisible to this harness
seeded sample of files per language, deterministic; not exhaustive over the corpus
coverage/fabrication baselines recorded; wave M14.1 must reduce missing/unexplained counts

a lane whose corpus checkout was not at its pin is measured in a detached worktree of the pin (see data.pinDrift); the measurement is of committed content, so an in-flight working-tree edit in a corpus repo is deliberately excluded from the differential

the measured code is this checkout's working tree, so `differential-code-inputs` fails — and the run exits 6 — when any analyzer, oracle or spec input differs from `regeneratedAtCommit`; a dirty tree can measure lanes but cannot claim them

#871 §1: the heuristic metric matches (label, normalized target) only — source re-attribution is invisible to it; fixture source/line pins are the coverage for attribution moves, and 'no regressions' here must not be read as 'attribution did not change'

#871 §1-2: perf rows record per-lane loadAvg1 and the run records loadAvgStart/End + slice count; a baseline row without load context is NOT scored (perfUnscoredLanes) rather than mislabelled as a regression; the lane-vs-run-median outlier check is DISCLOSED (medianOutliers) not scored — measured firing at load 3.9/8.7/~22 across ceremonies while the run median stayed put, it cannot separate machine load from lane slowness
